radar_layers.name: weather_radar:conus_base_reflectivity_mosaic
radar_layers.abstract: Weather radar base reflectivity mosaics of CONUS radar data from Weather Surveillance Radar 1988 Doppler (WSR-88D) sites operated by NWS and DOD and also from Terminal Doppler Weather Radars at major airports. The colors on the map represent the strength of the energy reflected back towards the radar measured in dBZ. The horizontal resolution is  1km (0.62 mi). The mosaics are updated approximately every 4 minutes. Data source: NWS & OAR Multi-Radar/Multi-Sensor (MRMS) System.
